product_one_liner.value: Formalize provides a GRC and compliance operations platform that helps organizations manage regulatory requirements and automate compliance workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes its platform as transforming compliance demands into actionable compliance workflows.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists a free trial and paid annual plans with quote-based pricing.

named_customers.notes: Arcano Partners appears in a published case study; Fieldfisher is identified as a customer on the company homepage.

employee_band.notes: Company careers profile reports 200 co-workers; LinkedIn company profile reports 201–500, but the direct careers headcount supports band 101–200 based on 200.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists Copenhagen as headquarters; funding announcement dateline places the company in Copenhagen, Denmark.

founded_year.notes: The careers profile and funding announcement state that Formalize was founded in 2021.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains compliance, product and platform material; it does not show two engineer-authored posts explaining product architecture, infrastructure or how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Formalize exposes API documentation and a public Help Center article.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists several openings but no role with AI, ML, machine learning, data science or the other specified AI/ML titles.

model_provider.notes: The security page does not name a model provider, and available product/docs/blog results did not establish a provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Formalize states that it has implemented the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 management system. Other standards mentioned on the page refer to AWS data-center certifications or third-party attestations, not company certifications.

last_funding.notes: The company announced a €30 million Series B on October 28, 2025. Converted approximately at the contemporaneous rate, €30 million is about US$34.8 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series B announcement is dated 2025-10, within 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists Sales Development Representative - Norway.

launched_6mo.notes: On 2026-05-19, Formalize announced a collaboration with ISO to embed official ISO standards directly in the platform, a major product capability announced within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A dated October 2026 report says co-founder Kristoffer Abell stepped up into a co-CEO role.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The accessible job-board, docs and integration results did not identify a CRM or sales/marketing system used by Formalize.
